feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only DX9Ex original pause menu and exact authored option arrows; excludes driving HUD, F11 ImGui, main-menu aspect, GOAL/+TIME, world markers and DX11/DXVK.
trace_stages: Original x86 option-arrow put_clip_sprite E8 callsites and exact SpriteNode ScreenHud producer token
Queue replay and renderer R30 EffectiveScope/CurrentSpriteQueueProducer per-draw identity
R30HudContainScale and R30PauseMenuVerticalFraction shared fixed XYZRHW, independent-eye fallback and shader projection
OpenXR per-eye FOV/viewport composition, desktop mode and resolution/reset fallback
subcomponents: Pause shell, option-arrow and selection highlight alignment via exact queue producer gate
Shared pause-only per-eye contain scale and signed vertical translation in all draw paths
Preservation of original input ownership and excluded gameplay/GOAL/F11/world geometry

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original pause shell and exact option-arrow sprites use same responsive 1.25 default/0.10 vertical transform without detaching selection controls
Paired XYZRHW, independent-eye fallback and WVP shader share pause offset/scale and preserve left/right coherence
Unrelated ScreenHud, GOAL/result, external F11, nonpause state, invalid offset, reset and world remain on their original owners
Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 host/game/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation gate succeed, hardware acceptance remains separate

diagnosis.original_evidence: User's 2026-10-13 Quest3/VDXR build 75ef9c91 shows tiny/upward pause menu; current source applied pause-only scale and Y shift to ScreenOverlay2D alone.
source_trace: Original OptionArrow_ClipSpriteCalls exact x86 E8 callers route through ExactScreenHud_putClipSprite.
SpriteNode exact callback records ProducerToken::ExactScreenHudClipSprite with RenderScope::ScreenHud.
R30 pause scale and vertical offset originally checked only ScreenOverlay2D, leaving exact pause arrow on gameplay HudScale.
diagnosis.root_cause: When current mode is STATE_SMPAUSEMENU, pause shell ScreenOverlay2D uses dedicated scale and offset, but its separate exact option arrow ScreenHud retains gameplay scale/zero Y offset, detaching the controls.
alternatives_rejected: A global ScreenHud -> pause promotion would also affect non-menu GOAL/position; gate only exact original arrow token in pause state.
Changing only VRPauseMenuScale or a global HudScale cannot align two differently-classified draw producers.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Per-draw token never grants world ownership; exact pause arrow joins shell's shared stereo HUD-plane affine in both eyes only within original game's pause state.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Added R30IsPauseMenuExactArrow and gated both pause contain scale and vertical offset; source-identity, numerical and destructive regression verification updated.
